column1: # Hungarian (hu). Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.

# percent_style has no space, as Android's Hungarian strings and NAVEE's Hungarian manual write it (85%). Other units take a no-break space (U+00A0): 25 km/h. quote_style is „…” outside, »…« inside. decimal_style is an example of the separators: the group mark is a no-break space (U+00A0), never U+202F, and four-digit numbers take no separator (1234,5), as CLDR's minimumGroupingDigits 2 says.
